CVE-2005-4872.title: Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 6.2 does ...
CVE-2005-4872.description: Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 6.2 does not properly count the number of named capturing subpatterns, which allows context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via a regular expression with a large number of named subpatterns, which triggers a buffer overflow. CVE-2006-7225.title: Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 6.7 allo ...

CVE-2006-7226.title: Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 6.7 does ...
CVE-2006-7226.description: Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 6.7 does not properly calculate the compiled memory allocation for regular expressions that involve a quantified "subpattern containing a named recursion or subroutine reference," which allows context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (error or crash).

CVE-2006-7227.title: Integer overflow in Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) lib ...
CVE-2006-7227.description: Integer overflow in Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 6.7 allows context-dependent attackers to execute arbitrary code via a regular expression containing a large number of named subpatterns (name_count) or long subpattern names (max_name_size), which triggers a buffer overflow. CVE-2006-7228.title: Integer overflow in Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) lib ...
CVE-2006-7228.description: Integer overflow in Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 6.7 might allow context-dependent attackers to execute arbitrary code via a regular expression that involves large (1) min, (2) max, or (3) duplength values that cause an incorrect length calculation and trigger a buffer overflow, a different vulnerability than CVE-2006-7227. CVE-2006-7230.title: Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) library before 7.0 does ...
